collection.description: Distracted by an argument, a father forgets a promised outing. His child waits by the path until sunset, clutching a small basket.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Distracted by an argument, (name1), a father, forgets a promised outing. His child waits by the path until sunset, clutching a small basket.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child is upset but appreciates his honesty.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child refuses to talk yet, and he respects that.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They choose a new day and prepare carefully.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child doubts he will remember, so he works to rebuild trust.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child asks for time together rather than gifts.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child says they want to be left alone for now.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: He changes how he manages promises and responsibilities.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: He recognizes a recurring problem that will take effort to fix.
